issues.quote: Total assets stood at sixty-five point seven million dollars at the end of fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Wrong unit: NVIDIA's total assets at the end of fiscal 2024 were about $65.7 billion, not million, so the figure is understated by a factor of 1,000.

data.summary: Revenue ($60.9B), growth (125.9% from $27.0B), net income ($29.8B), operating income ($33.0B) and cash ($7.3B) are correct. Total assets are wrongly given as $65.7 million; the correct figure is $65.7 billion.
